decision.explanation: C04 is the best-supported match because it most closely shares Q01's extended harmonic structure through approximately 210 Hz, persistent time evolution, and roughly 66.5-ms periodic framework. Q01 strongly redistributes energy upward—especially to 90.3 and 210.7 Hz and the 100–500-Hz band—so the match is broad pattern similarity rather than close amplitude or absolute-spectrum identity. Equal 10-s duration, 42-kHz sampling, 0.1-Hz FFT spacing and identical coverage make these frequency differences directly comparable.
